name: Novo mesto Stress Ribbon Footbridge
zag_role: Static and dynamic load testing in March 2023, in cooperation with dr Andrej Štrukelj (University of Maribor)
description: The first bridge in Slovenia built with stress ribbon technology. ZAG took part in the load test in March 2023, carried out by dr Andrej Štrukelj of the University of Maribor: static loading in three stages, dynamic testing with a light truck driven over artificial obstacles, and ambient vibration measurement. Vertical displacements, natural frequencies and mode shapes were compared against a finite element model and agreed well. Under 18 vehicles with a total mass of 70.4 t the calculated maximum deflection was 145 mm, and the measured values were up to 10 % smaller. Client was the City Municipality of Novo mesto, built by CGP Novo mesto with Freyssinet Adria, designed by Ponting Bridges and Pipenbaher Consulting Engineers.
history: The footbridge at Irca vas is the first stress ribbon bridge in Slovenia and crosses the Krka between Lastovce and Groblje. Ponting gives a span of 130 m, a width of 4 m and a deck thickness of 42 cm, assembled from 46 precast segments installed on fully tensioned bearing cables between anchored concrete block abutments. Freyssinet describes the same structure with a main span of 120.5 m and six tendons, and states that the grouted tendons are thought to be a first of their kind on this bridge type. The client was the City Municipality of Novo mesto and the contractor was a joint venture of Freyssinet Adria and CGP Novo mesto. The bridge received the Golden Pencil award in 2023 and the Plečnik Medal in 2024, and the City Municipality of Novo mesto refers to it as Štukljeva brv, after the Olympic gymnast Leon Štukelj.
facts: 131 m between abutment axes per the designers, clear span 120.6 m
46 precast segments (44 typical and 2 end elements) on four bearing tendons, with two further prestressing tendons
